rules: Source files and validators are not runtime evidence.
A missing evidence file must remain MISSING, never inferred PASS.
Production deployment requires a verifiable deploy ID and commit SHA.
Authenticated end-to-end status requires runtime evidence for each required journey.
Branch protection is not considered verified when the credentials cannot read its rules.
Candidate-reported submission is not provider-confirmed receipt or outcome.
The initial active-candidate cap is 500 and does not reduce route or institution scope.
All six candidate pathways remain available in the platform scope.
PayFast remains deferred until account and sandbox evidence are available.
